heading.title: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters

article.title: Twelve years.
article.content:
Article110Twelve years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part IX—Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
By a person excluded from a joint family property to enforce a right to share therein.
Period of limitationTwelve years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the exclusion becomes known to the plaintiff.
